system.summary: Simple substitution of invented letter-like signs for Italian letters, word division kept, a few word signs (et).
system.notes: Same alphabet in all three letters. Established from the R1125 slip alignment only; no key table built.

prior_solution.where: contemporary interlinear decipherments (R1123, R1124); decipherment slip filed with R1125

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Vestigia search 'Bonzagni': 46 items of Bonzagni's ASMo file; DECODE R1123/R1124/R1125 = b. 4 nos. 4, 6, 12 (Vestigia 1796, 1798, 1804).
Fetched the 11 DECODE images with the shared cookie.
Viewed every page: R1123 and R1124 carry contemporary interlinear decipherments over all cipher words; R1125 image 5 is a separate decipherment slip.

Aligned the slip ('Mando per Ladislao lator presto sei cavalli ...') with the first four lines of R1125's p. 3 cipher: word lengths agree and letters repeat consistently (sei, si, la, lator, poi, bacino, nove).

outcome.method_basis: R1123 and R1124 carry contemporary interlinear decipherments over every cipher word, and R1125's cipher block has a decipherment slip filed with it (DECODE image 5), which was aligned with the first four cipher lines to confirm it belongs.
outcome.notes: Read at the time. Added here only the check that the R1125 slip is the decipherment of its cipher block. Catalogue entry 155 removed; no write-up.
